What! Another Banana Cake!
By: Lady Catherine ...
Published: Tuesday, June 7, 2011 - 9:17pm

Ingredients




3 cups of all-purpose flour – sifted
5 ripe medium sized bananas
3 teaspoons baking powder
2 cups sugar – sifted
4 eggs
6 tablespoons unsalted butter – room temperature
1 teaspoon raspberry jam – or your favorite flavor
1 teaspoon orange marmalade
1/2 cup sour cream
1/2 cup buttermilk
1 tablespoon vanilla
7 cookies – crumbled (coconut or vanilla)
Topping:
1/2 tablespoon stick butter – 5- 6
2 tablespoons brown sugar
2 tablespoons flour

Preparation

1 Preheat Oven 350 degrees: 2 Grease a bundt pan with butter. 3 In a large mixing bowl combine the bananas, eggs, sour cream, buttermilk, vanilla, butter, raspberry jam and orange marmalade and mix well with an electric mixer. In a separate mixing bowl combine flour, sugar and baking powder. Combine with the wet ingredients and mix well with an electric mixer. 4 Topping: 5 Heat a small saucepan on low and add the butter, brown sugar and flour and combine well. 6 Pour half of the butter and brown sugar on the bottom of the bundt pan. Pour half of the cake batter on top of the butter and brown sugar mixture. Pour the other half of the butter and brown sugar and then pour the rest of the cake batter. 7 Crumble the cookies over the batter and bake for 45-50 minutes or until the toothpick test comes out clean.

About


This cake is a great way to use up the ripe bananas! It goes great with a cup of coffee or tea.
Enjoy with So Much Love,
Catherine
